title: On a wide touch tablet the card opens expanded with its buttons showing
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an active staff member at the test location with the "Sales Representative" switch on.
  • Use a customer with no Sales Representative assigned.
  • Create an open, uninvoiced work order for this test for that customer, with one approved labor line, one part and one "Sales Representative" field set to that staff member.
  • Open the work order on a touch tablet with no mouse, held so that its screen is at least 1024 pixels wide.
custom_steps:
1. Look at the work order card as it first opens, without tapping anything.
  2. Tap the + button.
  3. Tap "Sales Representative - Parts".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The card is not collapsed.
  • Lead Technician, Service Advisor and the Sales Representative field show without tapping the card's edit button.
  • The field shows its dropdown arrow without any hover.
  • The + button shows beside it at its full size, without any hover.

Step 2:

  • A menu opens.

Step 3:

  • The menu closes.
  • "Sales Representative - Labor" and "Sales Representative - Parts" show, in that order.
  • Without tapping them, both fields show their dropdown arrow, without any hover.
  • The remove x shows beside "Sales Representative - Parts", without any hover.

Chris Ward's answer 10 chose option (a) of the question sheet: on a wide touch screen with no mouse the card opens expanded, with the + and remove x always shown. Touch decides the buttons; the screen width decides whether the card is collapsed.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11266 (Story 2, Give a work order a separate Labor and Parts representative), story SV-11267 (Story 3, Set the representatives on a phone)

  • S3-R2: “The + and remove x buttons are always shown, at the same 32px size (S2-R1, S2-R8), and work as on a desktop (Story 2).”
  • S3-R4: “Nothing in the fields or the buttons depends on hover. On a touch screen the Sales Representative fields always show their dropdown arrow, as the + and remove x buttons always do. Lead Technician and Service Advisor keep today's behavior, where the arrow shows once the field is tapped.”
  • S2-R5: “Picking "Sales Representative - Parts" closes the menu and replaces the one field with two fields, in this order: "Sales Representative - Labor" and "Sales Representative - Parts".”

From: Chris Ward's answers to the Splitting Sales Representatives question sheet (answers 1 to 38, 19 Oct 2026; answers 39 and 40, 21 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward's answer 10: “10. (a) as the tech plan: touch decides the buttons, screen width decides whether the card is collapsed.”
